### God Will Provide the Ability You Need
Author: Jon Bloom
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/god-will-provide-the-ability-you-need
Passage: Exodus 31:6
Points:
- God often gives callings and duties—such as leadership or parenting—that feel far too heavy to carry alone.
- Though Moses received exhaustive instructions for the tabernacle, God provided relief by raising up gifted craftsmen like Bezalel and Oholiab.
- The Lord turned an overwhelming personal assignment into a shared endeavor, expanding "you shall make" into "they shall do."
- God supplies what we lack not by making us self-sufficient, but by giving abilities to others in our community.
- Like the diverse members of Christ's body, believers are designed to depend on one another's Spirit-given gifts.

### You Are Called by Name
Author: Daily Disciples
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-disciples/daily-disciples-devotional-october-31-11558261.html
Passage: Exodus 31:1-6
Points:
- God knows every believer individually by name and assigns a specific calling to each person's life.
- Bezalel and Oholiab were ordinary craftsmen empowered by the Holy Spirit with wisdom and skill for a holy purpose.
- Believers today possess the indwelling Holy Spirit, who serves as a divine helper and teacher for every assigned task.
- Walking worthy of our calling requires trusting God's Word in faith and persistently praying for spiritual wisdom and understanding.
